input.replyBody:
Hi Noah, thanks for reaching out, and sorry about the trouble logging in.

I checked, and all three password reset emails were sent and delivered to noah.kim@example.com this morning. That usually means they were sorted into another folder. To help you get in, we're sending you a one-time login link at the same address. With it, you can sign in without resetting your password.

To find it:
1. Check your Spam/Junk and Promotions folders.
2. Search your mailbox for "PawPlan".
3. Add no-reply@pawplan.app to your contacts so future emails go to your inbox.

Please use the newest email from us. If you still can't find anything, please check that noah.kim@example.com is the inbox you're looking in, and let us know. We're happy to help further!
